R649.note: Pure reordering is a no-op: flask_login.login_user only adds _user_id/_fresh/_id and never clears or rotates the session, so the pre-login session (and any attacker-planted keys) survives login exactly as before and the cart id written is the same form value either way - the fix needed session.clear() before login_user; it does at least break nothing.

R650.note: Only the Unix branch is closed; the Windows branch still runs cmd.exe /c, which re-parses the joined command line, and Java quotes an argument only when it contains a space or tab, so data like x&calc still injects.
